description: This file defines the `ListViewSubPanel` class, which manages displaying lists of objects in subpanels within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for initializing and rendering Smarty templates, processing list views, handling pagination, and generating dynamic headers and rows for subpanel listings. The class extends `ListView` and is specific to SuiteCRM's subpanel list rendering.

classes.name: ListViewSubPanel
classes.description: Manages the display and interaction of list views within subpanels, including template initialization, data processing, pagination controls, and list rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Smarty template object and calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: initNewSmartyTemplate
methods.description: Sets up a new Smarty template with the specified path, module strings, and optional image path, validating that the template file has a `.tpl` extension.

methods.name: getSmartyTemplate
methods.description: Returns the current Smarty template object.

methods.name: setSmartyTemplate
methods.description: Assigns a new Smarty template object.

methods.name: smartyTemplateAssign
methods.description: Assigns a variable to the Smarty template.

methods.name: createSmartyTemplate
methods.description: Creates a Smarty template object using the stored template path and assigns various local variables for rendering.

methods.name: setCurrentModule
methods.description: Sets the current module context and updates the Smarty template accordingly.

methods.name: process_dynamic_listview
methods.description: Processes and displays a dynamic list view for a subpanel, including headers and rows, integrating with Smarty templates.

methods.name: process_dynamic_listview_header
methods.description: Generates the header row for a subpanel list view, including sortable columns and icons.

methods.name: process_dynamic_listview_rows
methods.description: Renders the list rows for a subpanel, including checkboxes, fields, and custom logic, populating Smarty variables.

methods.name: processListNavigation
methods.description: Handles pagination navigation for list views, generating navigation buttons and URLs.

methods.name: processOrderBy
methods.description: Constructs and returns a URL for ordering the list view by a specific column, updating Smarty variables.
